limitations: Python 3.10 reached upstream end of life on 2026-10-01; it is included for compatibility testing, without upstream security support.
The selected interpreter patches are fixed in images/python-matrix/versions.json and installed during the build; runtime downloads are disabled.
Vendor harness CLIs and credentials are not part of this image.

changes: Add preinstalled Python 3.10, 3.12 and 3.14 compatibility interpreters, SQLite behavior validation, and tmux.
trixie.migration: New opt-in matrix line. Keep existing Python development pins unless the additional interpreters and tmux are needed; adopt its verified digest after publication.

purpose: Python 3.10, 3.12 and 3.14 compatibility testing with tmux and the Python development toolchain.
